summary: A watch of one account holding a stock: the download, then its P&L and the stock's at the first step; then the connection is dropped. The watch says it is lost and keeps its last picture, and stopping it afterwards sends nothing.

provenance.why: Nothing of the owner's account may be committed (the repository is public), so no account conversation is ever captured into it (ADR 0030, ADR 0031).
provenance.built: The account updates laid out as the account conversations are (account-stocks-and-options' provenance: ibapi 9.81's layout at server version 157, checked against a capture of the live gateway on 2026-11-23, none of whose values is in the repository). The P&L requests and their answers laid out from ib_async 2.1.0's client.py (reqPnL 92, cancelPnL 93, reqPnLSingle 94, cancelPnLSingle 95) and decoder.py (pnl 94: reqId, dailyPnL, unrealizedPnL, realizedPnL; pnlSingle 95: reqId, pos, dailyPnL, unrealizedPnL, realizedPnL, value), read on 2026-11-24: the layouts, not a capture. The figures a stream sends are given as `later` replies, each at a step of the replay, rather than at once.
provenance.invented: Every symbol, contract id, quantity, price, value, P&L, total, clock time and account id in this file is invented; the accounts are placeholders.

onStartApi: Market data farm connection is OK:usfarm
HMDS data farm connection is OK:ushmds
Sec-def data farm connection is OK:secdefil

onCancel: API client has been unsubscribed from account data.
